# Commodity: commodity (CMD)

A traded commodity with its benchmark, unit and venue. One row per commodity per business date, keyed by COMMODITY_ID. Read by the **market-data** pack's connector `market-store` (table `<root>/market/commodity/`). Delivered **daily**, 60 business days (2026-07-08 to 2026-09-30): the first day's file is a **full snapshot** (8 records); each later day's file holds only the records new or changed that day (8–8 a day). Drishti applies a day's file by key over the day before: a record absent from a day's file keeps its previous version, and nothing is ever deleted (an end is a changed status). 480 rows in all.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/market-data/commodity/` + `changes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `COMMODITY_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the business date is the file's date (`snapshot-` or `changes-YYYY-MM-DD`), which becomes the lake's partition `business_date` |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | a full snapshot on the first day, then only the changed records |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `COMMODITY_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^CMD-` | `"CMD-BRENT"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The commodity's name (Brent crude oil, Gold …). | one of `Brent crude oil`, `Copper`, `Corn`, `Gold`, `Henry Hub natural gas`, `Silver`, `Soybeans`, `WTI crude oil` | `"Brent crude oil"` |
| `FRONT` | number | required | The front-month futures price (the last OHLC close), in UNIT. | unit: UNIT | `78.65` |
| `UNIT` | string | required | The quotation unit of the prices: currency per physical unit (USD/bbl, USD/oz, USc/bu is US cents per bushel …). | one of `USD/MMBtu`, `USD/bbl`, `USD/lb`, `USD/oz`, `USc/bu` | `"USD/bbl"` |
| `EXCHANGE` | string | required | The exchange the futures trade on (ICE, NYMEX, COMEX, CBOT). | one of `CBOT`, `COMEX`, `ICE`, `NYMEX` | `"ICE"` |
| `SECTOR` | string | required | The commodity sector: Energy, Metals or Agriculture. | one of `Agriculture`, `Energy`, `Metals` | `"Energy"` |
| `OHLC` | array of objects | required | The front month's daily bars, oldest first: one object per business day (open, high, low and close in UNIT, and a volume). | — | [60 objects] |
| `OHLC[].DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | A business day of the daily bars, oldest first, ending at the record's date. | — | `"2026-04-14"` |
| `OHLC[].OPEN` | number | required | The front contract's opening price that day, in SPEC.UNIT. | unit: SPEC.UNIT | `96.27` |
| `OHLC[].HIGH` | number | required | The day's high price, in SPEC.UNIT. | unit: SPEC.UNIT | `98.33` |
| `OHLC[].LOW` | number | required | The day's low price, in SPEC.UNIT. | unit: SPEC.UNIT | `95.63` |
| `OHLC[].CLOSE` | number | required | The day's closing (settlement) price, in SPEC.UNIT. | unit: SPEC.UNIT | `96.88` |
| `OHLC[].VOLUME` | integer | required | The number of contracts traded that day. | unit: contracts | `138952` |
| `SPEC` | object | required | The futures contract's specification: contract code, unit, exchange, settlement, listing cycle, tick size, trading hours. | — | {…} |
| `SPEC.CONTRACT` | string | required | The contract's code (WTI, BRENT, NG, GOLD, SILVER, COPPER, CORN, SOY). | one of `BRENT`, `COPPER`, `CORN`, `GOLD`, `NG`, `SILVER`, `SOY`, `WTI` | `"BRENT"` |
| `SPEC.UNIT` | string | required | The price unit (e.g. USD/bbl, USD/MMBtu, USD/oz, USD/lb, USc/bu). | one of `USD/MMBtu`, `USD/bbl`, `USD/lb`, `USD/oz`, `USc/bu` | `"USD/bbl"` |
| `SPEC.EXCHANGE` | string | required | The exchange the contract is listed on (NYMEX, ICE, COMEX, CBOT). | one of `CBOT`, `COMEX`, `ICE`, `NYMEX` | `"ICE"` |
| `SPEC.SETTLEMENT` | string | required | How the contract settles: Physical or Physical (vault). | one of `Physical`, `Physical (vault)` | `"Physical"` |
| `SPEC.LISTING` | string | required | The contract months listed (Monthly). | — | `"Monthly"` |
| `SPEC.TICK_SIZE` | number | required | The minimum price move, in SPEC.UNIT. | unit: SPEC.UNIT | `0.01` |
| `SPEC.TRADING_HOURS` | string | required | The exchange's trading hours, as text. | — | `"Sun-Fri 18:00-17:00 ET"` |
| `COMMODITY_CURVE` | string | required | Its futures curve: a CURVE_ID of the market-data pack's commodity-curve kind (CMDC-…). | pattern `^CMDC-`; links to `commodity-curve` | `"CMDC-BRENT"` |
| `COMMODITY_VOL_SURFACE` | string | required | Its volatility surface: a SURFACE_ID of the market-data pack's commodity-vol-surface kind (CMDV-…). | pattern `^CMDV-`; links to `commodity-vol-surface` | `"CMDV-BRENT"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 480 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `COMMODITY_ID` per `business_date`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `COMMODITY_ID`, `NAME`, `FRONT`, `UNIT`, `EXCHANGE`, `SECTOR`, `OHLC`, `SPEC`, `COMMODITY_CURVE`, `COMMODITY_VOL_SURFACE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Each day: the records new or changed that day (or all of them); Drishti keeps the rest from the day before.
- Unique: `COMMODITY_ID` per business_date.
- `COMMODITY_ID` matches `^CMD-`.
